title: Atlas DataFlow Execution Contract
description: Schema defining the execution contract family governing training preparation, runtime inference, and contract projections. Project Spec S0243 refactors this schema into a closed discriminated union keyed by contract_version: execution_contract.v1 (unchanged in meaning -- tabular classification/regression) and execution_contract.v2 (new, strict, univariate-forecasting-only branch). A document must validate against exactly one branch; a document mixing v1 and v2 fields, or declaring an unknown contract_version, validates against neither and is rejected. Execution-only fields that drive training are explicitly separated from runtime/public projection fields. Human-facing field descriptions, validation hints, and review notes from the human-facing contract draft (M22) are deliberately excluded from v1 -- those belong to the promotion validator (M23-02) as reviewed human intent, not as executable operational rules. Project Spec S0258 confirms (without any structural change) that execution_contract.v1's existing hist_gradient_boosting fixed_model_configuration branch already governs Atlas-native binary fixed-configuration training identically to the existing multiclass case -- see the hist_gradient_boosting_hyperparameters allOf branch and modeling_constraints.allowed_model_families below.

allOf.description: Project Spec S0231: when modeling_constraints.fixed_model_configuration.model_family is hist_gradient_boosting AND result_semantics.problem_type is continuous_regression, the fixed hyperparameters must be the bounded continuous-regression HGB shape (no class_weight, no random_state).

Project Spec S0231: every other hist_gradient_boosting fixed_model_configuration (result_semantics absent, or problem_type other than continuous_regression -- including the existing S0216 multiclass native case) keeps requiring the existing classification hyperparameter shape unchanged. Project Spec S0258 confirms this same branch is also the governing shape for binary_classification: a reviewed fixed_configuration modeling_constraints alongside a binary_result_semantics (problem_type binary_classification) never matches the continuous_regression branch above, so it falls through here and is required to declare exactly one allowed_model_families entry -- hist_gradient_boosting -- with the closed hist_gradient_boosting_hyperparameters shape (no additional fixed binary family is ever accepted). The historical binary evaluate_allowed_families selection_mode remains entirely unchanged and is never forced into fixed_configuration.

contract_version.description: Fixed contract schema version identifier. Must always equal 'execution_contract.v1'. Used to detect contract version incompatibilities during promotion validation (M23-02) and projection derivation (M23-04). Not a semantic version — the runtime contract projection carries its own schema_version.

dataset_id.description: Dataset identifier. Must match the dataset slug used in the contracts directory (e.g., 'bank-marketing'). Used to associate this execution contract with its dataset-specific subdirectory and runtime contract instance.

target_column.description: Name of the column to predict. Must not appear in feature_columns or ignored_columns. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime contract features list, since the target is never an inference input.

feature_columns.description: Ordered list of column names used as model inputs. Must be disjoint from ignored_columns and must not include target_column. Each name must have a corresponding entry in feature_definitions. Projected into the runtime contract features list via M23-04 projection derivation.

ignored_columns.description: Columns present in the dataset but excluded from both training and inference. Must not overlap with feature_columns or target_column. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

required_columns.description: Subset of feature_columns that must be present in every inference payload. Projected into the runtime contract as feature.required: true. Must be a subset of feature_columns.

optional_columns.description: Subset of feature_columns that may be absent from an inference payload without triggering a validation failure. Projected into the runtime contract as feature.required: false. Must be a subset of feature_columns. The union of required_columns and optional_columns must equal feature_columns.

feature_definitions.description: Per-feature type and domain constraint definitions, keyed by feature name. Each key must be a name declared in feature_columns. Provides the type and domain information required to derive the runtime contract feature list in M23-04. Only feature_columns entries are permitted as keys — target_column and ignored_columns must not appear here. Human-facing descriptions, validation hints, and review notes from the human-facing contract draft are deliberately absent — those are reviewed intent (M22), not executable rules.

missing_value_policy.description: Per-feature missing value handling strategy, keyed by feature name. Each key must be a name declared in feature_columns. Governs pipeline preprocessing only — not runtime inference behavior. Human-facing 'validation_hint' fields from the M22 human-facing contract draft are deliberately not carried here.

categorical_encoding_policy.description: Default encoding strategy applied to all categorical features. Execution-only — governs training preprocessing, not public-facing projection. Not projected into the runtime or public contract.

numeric_handling.description: Numeric feature preprocessing approach applied to all numeric features before training. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

allowed_transformations.description: List of column transformations permitted under this contract. An empty array means no transformations beyond encoding and scaling are applied. Execution-only.

split_policy.description: Dataset partitioning configuration for training, validation, and testing phases. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

random_seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility across training runs. Null indicates non-deterministic training. Execution-only.

primary_metric.description: Primary evaluation metric used to select the best model checkpoint during training. Execution-only — not projected into the runtime or public contract.

secondary_metrics.description: Candidate secondary evaluation metrics computed during training for monitoring. May be empty. Execution-only.

modeling_constraints.description: Constraints bounding the model family selection space and training strategy. Does not select a specific model — constrains what is permissible for this dataset. Execution-only.

result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0108: optional, backward-compatible normalized binary-result semantics. Present only on new binary execution contracts with a reviewed, approved binary_result_semantics_intent; strictly validated when present. Excludes authoring-only fields such as review status/notes — those remain in the dataset modeling intent, not here.

model_source_mode.description: Project Spec S0157: optional, backward-compatible explicit model-source declaration. Absent means atlas_internal_training (legacy behavior, unchanged). validated_external_fitted_model is only ever an explicit declaration -- never inferred from model_family, modeling_constraints, or any other field -- and is rejected by the governed training entrypoint (pipeline/training.py) before estimator construction or fit.

execution_contract_v2.description: Project Spec S0243: strict, univariate-forecasting-only execution contract branch. Closed and disjoint from execution_contract_v1 -- additionalProperties is false and no v1 tabular field (feature_columns, split_policy, modeling_constraints, etc.) is a member of this branch. Never carries actual future forecast periods/values, model metadata, or a confidence/prediction interval contract -- those remain owned by later, separately governed contracts.

contract_version.description: Fixed contract schema version identifier for the univariate-forecasting execution-contract branch. Must always equal 'execution_contract.v2'.

dataset_id.description: Dataset identifier. Must match the dataset slug used in the contracts directory.

problem_type.description: Closed problem-type discriminator for this branch. Only 'univariate_forecasting' is governed by execution_contract.v2.

target_column.description: The single, exact forecasted target column identity. Never a list -- execution_contract.v2 governs exactly one target-column identity.

time_index_column.description: The single, exact time-index column identity, sourced from and cross-checked against dataset-semantic-intent.v4 temporal_semantics.time_index_field_name.

index_value_kind.description: Kind of the temporal index's values, sourced from dataset-semantic-intent.v4 temporal_semantics.index_value_kind.

frequency.description: Non-empty, dataset-specific authored logical frequency identifier, sourced from dataset-semantic-intent.v4 temporal_semantics.frequency. Never a pandas/NumPy/statsmodels-specific alias vocabulary.

source_exogenous_predictors.description: Fixed: this univariate forecasting execution contract never includes source exogenous predictors. Never a generic feature_columns list.

forecast_horizon.description: Positive integer forecast horizon, sourced only from candidate-preparation-recipe.v2 and cross-checked against its backtesting.forecast_horizon. Never hardcoded to a dataset-specific constant by this schema.

temporal_evaluation.description: Reduced temporal-evaluation facts projected from candidate-preparation-recipe.v2. Never copies the full fold_schedule, raw periods, target values, validation values, predictions, or residuals.

evaluation_policy.description: Materialized, bounded forecasting evaluation policy. Declares which metrics apply and their governed direction; never computes a metric value.

result_semantics.description: Strict, normalized univariate-forecasting result semantics. Required on every execution_contract.v2 document -- forecasting has no result-semantics-optional tabular fallback shape.

training_policy.description: Project Spec S0244: strict, normalized, frozen forecasting training-policy specification materialized from a reviewed, approved univariate_forecasting_training_policy_intent. Required on every execution_contract.v2 document. Never reuses v1 modeling_constraints/training_policy_intent shape -- forecasting training is dataset-neutral, fixed-configuration only, and never performs model selection.

random_seed.description: Random seed for downstream reproducibility. Null is representable and is never interpreted as permission for nondeterministic behavior. Not governed or required by S0243 itself.

forecasting_temporal_evaluation.description: Reduced facts needed for downstream execution, projected from candidate-preparation-recipe.v2. Never carries fold_schedule[], development/holdout start/end labels, raw periods, target values, validation values, predictions, or residuals -- those remain owned by preparation/evidence.

forecasting_metric_entry.description: One strict, bounded forecasting evaluation metric entry. seasonal_mase requires an explicit positive seasonal_period; mae/rmse must never carry one. No metric value is ever computed or recorded here.

forecasting_evaluation_policy.description: Materialized forecasting evaluation policy. primary_metric and every secondary_metrics entry are strict forecasting_metric_entry objects. Uniqueness of secondary metric ids and non-duplication of the primary metric within secondary_metrics are enforced by the materializer, not restated structurally here.

univariate_forecasting_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0243: strict normalized univariate-forecasting result semantics materialized from a reviewed, approved univariate_forecasting_result_semantics_intent. Defines semantics only, never a persisted prediction instance -- rejects classification/regression-only fields (positive_class, classes, probability_output, threshold, decision, interpretation, risk bands, predicted_value) and runtime-instance fields (period, timestamp, forecast, forecast_points, confidence_interval, prediction_interval, model_descriptor) by construction via additionalProperties: false.

univariate_forecasting_training_policy.description: Project Spec S0244: strict, normalized, frozen univariate-forecasting training-policy specification materialized from a reviewed, approved univariate_forecasting_training_policy_intent. Never carries review_status/review_notes -- those remain authoring-only fields on the dataset modeling intent, not on the execution contract. Never reuses execution_contract_v1's modeling_constraints/fixed_model_configuration shape (which is classification/regression-scoped and permits a different, disjoint set of model families).

deterministic_seasonal_trend_ols_fixed_c.description: Project Spec S0244: the complete, explicit, library-neutral set of whitelisted deterministic_seasonal_trend_ols hyperparameters. No statsmodels/sklearn constructor path, module path, class path, or callable is ever a member of this shape. reference_season_position must be strictly less than seasonal_period -- enforced by the independent Python materializer/builder, since JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express this cross-field constraint generically without a fixed seasonal_period value.

seasonal_period.description: Explicit, dataset-specific governed seasonal period. Must never be hardcoded to 12 or any other dataset-specific constant by this schema itself.

reference_season_position.description: Explicit, dataset-specific omitted reference seasonal indicator position. Must be strictly less than seasonal_period.

univariate_forecasting_finalization_poli.description: Project Spec S0244: the one frozen finalization/fit protocol every execution_contract.v2 training_policy must declare. Every field is a fixed constant -- there is no configurable finalization protocol variant.

feature_definition.description: Execution-level definition of a single feature column. Provides the type and optional domain constraints used to derive the runtime contract feature entry in M23-04. Human-facing descriptions and validation hints from the M22 human-facing contract draft are deliberately excluded — this schema encodes executable operational rules only, not reviewed human intent.

type.description: Feature type. Bounded vocabulary matching the runtime contract convention. Projected into runtime_contract feature.type via M23-04.

domain_constraints.description: Optional value domain constraints. Shape is determined by the feature type: numeric features use numeric_domain_constraints (min/max); categorical features use categorical_domain_constraints (values list). Must be absent for boolean features. Projected into runtime_contract feature.domain_constraints via M23-04.

input_policy.description: Project Spec S0156: optional, backward-compatible runtime input-normalization policy, distinct from the generic training missing_value_policy above. Carried verbatim into the runtime contract projection. Absent for every feature that does not explicitly declare one.

numeric_domain_constraints.description: Value range constraints for numeric features. Mirrors the runtime contract convention to allow direct projection into runtime_contract feature.domain_constraints.

categorical_domain_constraints.description: Enumerated accepted-value guidance for categorical features. Mirrors the runtime contract convention to allow direct projection into runtime_contract feature.domain_constraints. Exactly one of the legacy 'values' vocabulary and the Project Spec S0156 'known_values' vocabulary may be declared -- both present simultaneously is a contradictory dual declaration and is rejected structurally.

values.description: Legacy: non-empty list of accepted string values for this categorical feature. Absence of validation_behavior alongside 'values' preserves the existing closed-domain (reject_unknown) rejection semantics.

known_values.description: Project Spec S0156: non-empty, typed list of known values for this categorical feature -- rendering/documentation/evidence guidance, independent from validation_behavior. Every item must share the declared categorical_value_type scalar type; booleans are never accepted as integer known values.

categorical_value_type.description: Project Spec S0156: the declared scalar type of this categorical feature's values. Required whenever known_values is declared.

validation_behavior.description: Project Spec S0156: explicit runtime unknown-category behavior. reject_unknown preserves the existing closed-domain behavior; ignore_and_report accepts a correctly-typed unknown value, preserves it unchanged, and emits a bounded UNKNOWN_CATEGORY_ACCEPTED observation. Never inferred from model family or dataset slug.

input_policy.description: Project Spec S0156: runtime input-normalization policy for a single feature, distinct from generic training missing_value_policy. Every listed behavior must be explicit and schema-validated.

conditional_blank_normalization.description: Project Spec S0156: a deterministic, side-effect-free conditional blank-input normalization rule. Distinct from generic learned missing-value imputation -- no learned strategy is ever applied here. A feature carrying this policy may remain required: true while still accepting an explicitly declared blank representation only under its declared condition.

accepted_representation.description: The only accepted blank input representation: a string that is empty after trimming leading/trailing whitespace.

when.description: The deterministic equality condition that must hold against another declared feature for the blank representation to be accepted.

materialized_value.description: The fixed constant value the accepted blank representation is normalized to when the condition holds. Never learned or inferred.

otherwise.description: Behavior when the condition does not hold: the blank representation is rejected with a stable, dedicated conditional-missing validation failure.

null_behavior.description: JSON null is never reclassified as an accepted blank representation, regardless of the condition.

equality_condition.description: Project Spec S0156: a bounded, deterministic equality comparison against another declared feature. Never an arbitrary expression, regex program, callable reference, or code string.

field.description: Name of another declared feature (must exist in feature_columns and must not reference the feature that owns this condition).

value.description: The comparison value. Must be compatible with the referenced feature's declared scalar type.

missing_value_strategy.description: Missing value handling strategy for a single feature: mean/median/mode imputation, constant fill, or row exclusion from the training dataset.

categorical_encoding.description: Encoding strategy for categorical features. onehot: one-hot encoding; ordinal: integer ordinal encoding; target_encode: mean-target encoding; binary: binary encoding.

numeric_handling_strategy.description: Preprocessing approach for numeric features. standardize: z-score scaling (zero mean, unit variance); normalize: min-max scaling to [0, 1]; passthrough: no scaling applied.

transformation.description: Permitted column transformation. log1p: natural log of (1 + x); sqrt: square root; clip: clip to domain_constraints bounds; passthrough: no transformation.

split_policy.description: Dataset split configuration. The three ratios must sum to 1.0 (enforced by the training pipeline, not by this schema).

strategy.description: Split strategy. stratified: preserves class distribution of target_column in each split; random: uniform random split without class stratification.

train_ratio.description: Proportion of the dataset allocated to the training split.

val_ratio.description: Proportion of the dataset allocated to the validation split. May be zero if no validation split is required.

test_ratio.description: Proportion of the dataset allocated to the test split.

metric.description: Evaluation metric identifier. Scoped to Atlas classification use cases. roc_auc: area under ROC curve; f1: F1 score; accuracy: classification accuracy; log_loss: cross-entropy loss; pr_auc: area under precision-recall curve (this project's existing internal-training identifier, computed via average_precision_score). Project Spec S0157 additions for the external fitted-model evidence profile: average_precision (a distinct canonical identifier from pr_auc -- both remain valid and are never silently translated into one another; pr_auc is this project's established internal-training name, average_precision is the external evidence profile's own name for the same class of ranking metric, kept separate so provenance is never lost); precision; recall; f2 (F-beta with beta=2, recall-weighted); balanced_accuracy; brier_score (mean squared error of predicted probabilities, lower_is_better semantics, distinct from log_loss). Project Spec S0216 explicit multiclass-native aggregate additions: f1_macro, f1_weighted, precision_macro, recall_macro -- each a distinct, explicit multiclass aggregate identifier, never a silent reinterpretation of the binary-era f1/precision/recall ids (those never carry multiclass averaging semantics). Project Spec S0223 continuous-regression vocabulary additions: r2 (coefficient of determination; higher_is_better), mae (mean absolute error; lower_is_better), rmse (root mean squared error; lower_is_better) -- contract/training-policy vocabulary only; selecting r2/mae/rmse at contract-policy level does not imply metric computation support. The governed internal training entrypoint (pipeline/training.py) computes roc_auc/f1/accuracy/log_loss/pr_auc for binary native training and additionally accuracy/balanced_accuracy/f1_macro/f1_weighted/precision_macro/recall_macro/log_loss for fixed-configuration native multiclass training; every other identifier is schema-valid vocabulary for evidence artifacts and fails closed with a stable unsupported_metric error if ever selected as an internal training primary_metric outside those two governed sets. pipeline/training.py does not compute r2/mae/rmse as of S0223. Project Spec S0243's mae/rmse/seasonal_mase forecasting evaluation-policy vocabulary is governed exclusively by execution_contract.v2's own forecasting_metric_entry definition, not by this v1-scoped metric enum -- seasonal_mase is intentionally never added here.

modeling_constraints.description: Constraints bounding the model selection space for this dataset. Does not select a model — constrains what model families and training strategies are permissible. Scoped to Atlas classification use cases.

allowed_model_families.description: Non-empty list of permitted model family identifiers. Training must use only families declared here. Scoped to the Atlas classification model families — broader ML families are out of scope for this contract. Project Spec S0157 introduced hist_gradient_boosting as vocabulary for a validated_external_fitted_model contract's declared family. Project Spec S0216 additionally authorizes it for Atlas-native multiclass training: pipeline/training.py's internal supported-family registry now constructs and fits a HistGradientBoostingClassifier only when task_type is classification, modeling_constraints.selection_mode is fixed_configuration, and fixed_model_configuration.model_family is hist_gradient_boosting. Project Spec S0231 additionally authorizes the same hist_gradient_boosting identifier for Atlas-native continuous-regression fixed-configuration training (HistGradientBoostingRegressor) when result_semantics.problem_type is continuous_regression; the fixed hyperparameter shape is discriminated by result_semantics.problem_type rather than by a second parallel model_family identifier. Project Spec S0258 additionally authorizes Atlas-native binary fixed-configuration training (HistGradientBoostingClassifier) when result_semantics.problem_type is binary_classification and selection_mode is fixed_configuration -- the historical binary evaluate_allowed_families selection_mode (with any allowed_model_families composition, never requiring hist_gradient_boosting) remains completely unchanged and is never forced into fixed_configuration.

no_automl.description: When true, prohibits automated model selection and hyperparameter search (AutoML). Training must use one of the allowed_model_families with explicitly configured parameters.

max_training_time_seconds.description: Optional upper bound on training wall-clock time in seconds. Null means no time constraint is imposed.

selection_mode.description: Project Spec S0216: optional, backward-compatible native training selection strategy. Absent preserves the historical evaluate_allowed_families behavior (train and compare every allowed_model_families candidate, select by primary_metric). fixed_configuration requires exactly one fixed_model_configuration entry whose model_family also appears exactly once in allowed_model_families, and authorizes no model/hyperparameter selection at all -- the fixed configuration is fit as-is.

fixed_model_configuration.description: Project Spec S0216: required exactly when selection_mode is fixed_configuration; absent otherwise. Bounded, explicit fixed hyperparameter configuration for one model family -- never a callable, module path, or class string.

Project Spec S0216: a single bounded fixed model configuration for modeling_constraints.selection_mode = fixed_configuration. hyperparameters is discriminated strictly by model_family -- only the named model_family's own allowed hyperparameter shape may match, and it must be complete (no partial supply): unknown hyperparameter names or callable/module/class-string values are always rejected. Project Spec S0224 additionally authorizes gradient_boosting and random_forest as bounded fixed continuous-regression families -- each with its own closed hyperparameter shape, never the hist_gradient_boosting shape.

model_family.description: Project Spec S0216 introduces the first bounded fixed-parameter family (hist_gradient_boosting, multiclass classification only). Project Spec S0224 adds gradient_boosting and random_forest, bounded fixed continuous-regression families only. random_state is never part of hyperparameters -- it always remains governed by the top-level execution-contract random_seed.

hyperparameters.description: Discriminated strictly by model_family via the allOf below -- hist_gradient_boosting_hyperparameters, gradient_boosting_regression_hyperparameters, or random_forest_regression_hyperparameters.

hist_gradient_boosting_hyperparameters.description: Project Spec S0216: the complete, explicit set of whitelisted hist_gradient_boosting hyperparameters for a fixed_configuration native multiclass run. No other estimator parameter name is ever accepted, and no field here may ever be a callable, module path, or class string. Project Spec S0259 adds optional max_depth (null or integer >= 1), also governing the same shape's use for native binary fixed_configuration training -- never required, never dataset-specific.

hist_gradient_boosting_regression_hyperp.description: Project Spec S0231: the complete, explicit set of whitelisted hist_gradient_boosting hyperparameters for a fixed_configuration native continuous-regression run (sklearn.ensemble.HistGradientBoostingRegressor). Never includes class_weight (classification-only, see hist_gradient_boosting_hyperparameters) or random_state -- random_state is never part of hyperparameters and always remains governed by the top-level execution-contract random_seed. No other estimator parameter name is ever accepted.

gradient_boosting_regression_hyperparame.description: Project Spec S0224: the complete, explicit set of whitelisted gradient_boosting hyperparameters for a fixed_configuration native continuous-regression run (sklearn.ensemble.GradientBoostingRegressor). No other estimator parameter name is ever accepted -- in particular random_state, n_jobs, and any callable/module path/class string are always rejected -- and every field must be a bounded scalar constructor input.

random_forest_regression_hyperparameters.description: Project Spec S0224: the complete, explicit set of whitelisted random_forest hyperparameters for a fixed_configuration native continuous-regression run (sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestRegressor). No other estimator parameter name is ever accepted -- in particular random_state, n_jobs, and any callable/module path/class string are always rejected -- and every field must be a bounded scalar constructor input.

result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0223: closed discriminated union of normalized machine-readable result semantics. Exactly one of binary_result_semantics (Project Spec S0108), multiclass_result_semantics (Project Spec S0207), or continuous_regression_result_semantics (Project Spec S0223) may match -- all three definitions are additionalProperties: false with disjoint required-field shapes, so a document can never satisfy more than one branch or mix fields across them.

binary_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0108: normalized machine-readable binary-result semantics materialized from a reviewed, approved binary_result_semantics_intent. Excludes authoring-only fields such as review_status/review notes.

class_id.description: The reviewed final positive technical class ID. Distinct from the public event meaning.

event_label.description: The reviewed public meaning of the positive event. Distinct from the technical class ID.

threshold.description: Reviewed decision threshold, distinct from the interpretation bands below.

bands.description: Ordered, contiguous, non-overlapping risk bands covering [0, 1] exactly: low, medium, high, each once. Interval semantics are lower_bound <= probability < upper_bound, except the final band's upper bound 1.0 is inclusive. Full ordering/contiguity is enforced by the materialization pipeline, not by this schema alone.

multiclass_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0207: normalized machine-readable strict multiclass-result semantics materialized from a reviewed, approved multiclass_result_semantics_intent and a valid dataset-semantic-intent.v2 governed class declaration. Never defines a positive/negative class, a threshold, or a risk interpretation -- those remain exclusively binary_result_semantics concepts.

class_id.description: Stable, authored identifier for this governed class, sourced only from dataset-semantic-intent.v2 target_semantics.classes.

display_label.description: Human-readable display label for this governed class.

classes.description: The complete, normatively ordered set of governed classes. Array order is normative and must never be sorted or re-derived. uniqueItems is a structural safeguard only -- duplicate class_id values across otherwise-distinct objects are rejected by the materialization pipeline, not by this schema alone.

continuous_regression_result_semantics.description: Project Spec S0223: normalized machine-readable strict continuous-regression result semantics materialized from a reviewed, approved continuous_regression_result_semantics_intent and a valid dataset-semantic-intent.v3 governed continuous target declaration. Never defines a positive/negative class, classes, a probability output, a threshold, a decision strategy, an interpretation/risk band, count/exposure/offset semantics, or a multi-output target list -- units, public display labels and observed numeric ranges belong to later dataset/public/result-presentation contracts, not this normalized result behavior contract.
